name: Early Bantu expansion
short_desc: Bantu-speaking communities begin a long expansion that reshapes languages, farming and populations across much of Africa.
date_note: An approximate window for the beginning of the expansion, not the duration of later migrations. Routes and timing remain debated.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A continent-scale demographic and linguistic transformation missing from a catalog with extensive European and Eurasian population history. Evidence and date rationale: The 2023 genomic study describes an expansion beginning 6,000–4,000 years ago. The stored 4000–2000 BCE bounds are a rounded calendar orientation for that uncertain onset, not the duration of later migrations and not a viewer-relative BP conversion. Routes and timing remain debated. Primary evidence: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06770-6. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
